title: TemplateFillFacts
description: The in-place firm-template fill's decision record (P17/C8, B75§3c) — the writeback-facts pattern for the firm_default lane, in its own vocabulary: a fill records SECTIONS replaced (guidance stripped, placeholder removed), not cells written. Every section the template carries appears exactly once — filled by the engine, filled by hand from the hand-completion record (P26a item 1, P1-27), honestly left carrying its guidance, owed to a human, or refused with the reason — so 'what still needs a human?' is answerable by looking (remaining_guidance + remaining_by_hand). The template at config/ is never mutated. Every fill writes the WORKING copy (working_copy, under exports/review/: authoring scaffolding stripped, hand values in, unfilled guidance kept for the hand-drafter); the buyer copy (output_file, under exports/submission/) is written ONLY when nothing remains — buyer_copy_produced says which happened.

plan_sha256.description: The frozen plan whose sections fed the fill — prose comes only from what it names.

draft_sha256.description: The exact envelope whose section prose landed in the template.

confirmed_by.description: The human who confirmed the previewed fill (S7) — it never runs unconfirmed.

template_file.description: The firm template the copy was made FROM (config/templates/…).

template_sha256.description: Must equal the reference_sha256 the path_b_outline checkpoint recorded — the fill only touches the EXACT template the plan was built against (the digest-bound-source rule, B74§3b).

output_file.description: The buyer copy under exports/submission/ — for firm_default pursuits this IS the to-the-buyer document (B75§1d: it replaces the generated response.docx). Written only when buyer_copy_produced is true; the path is named either way so the record reads the same.

working_copy.description: The working copy under exports/review/ — written on EVERY fill: front matter and instruction text stripped, hand values rendered, guidance kept for sections a human still drafts. Listed under internal_do_not_send, never to the buyer.

buyer_copy_produced.description: true = output_file was written this fill because nothing remained; false = withheld (the bundle records the deliverable as refused with the itemized reason).

scaffolding_removed.description: The authoring scaffolding stripped from both copies, by text: the template title, the 'How to Use This Template' heading, its instruction paragraph — every body element before the first numbered section except the metadata table.

section_id.description: The plan section whose prose fed (or should have fed) this template section.

slot_id.description: The template slot (s-hNN…) the section bound through based_on.

docx_anchor.description: The template heading, verbatim — placement is re-derived by reparse (guidance_box_map), never persisted.

decision.description: filled = section prose REPLACED the guidance box and the placeholder table was removed (replacement-not-insertion); filled_by_hand = the hand-completion record (exports/hand-fill.json) supplied every field and the values were rendered in place; kept_guidance = no drafted prose for this section, so its guidance survives IDENTICAL in the working copy — the honest outcome, reported in remaining_guidance; fill_by_hand = a human still owes this slot (metadata record, grid, case block, inline bracketed line — B75§1e) and it is reported in remaining_by_hand; refused_unnamed = the frozen plan names no section for this template anchor.

fields_written.description: filled_by_hand / fill_by_hand: the field keys whose values were rendered (a partial record renders what it has and stays owed).

paragraphs.description: filled: how many delivered paragraphs replaced the guidance box.

placeholder_removed.description: filled: the '[ Replace with … ]' placeholder table was deleted too — the v1 gap fixed (v1 shipped documents still carrying them).

remaining_guidance.description: The guidance texts still in the working copy — the prose sections a human still drafts (v1's remaining_guidance reporter, now on the record). Hand-completed shapes report under remaining_by_hand, not here.

remaining_by_hand.description: The hand-completion slots still owed, one line each — path plus the missing fields — the itemized reason the buyer copy is withheld. Enter them through PUT /api/pursuits/{pursuit_id}/writeback/hand-fill.
